notes: The photo director explains itself when it sits out. The first capped LoRA run showed the director failing silently — no 'director:' line, no reason — leaving photos to plain keyword matching, which loaded a nude LoRA and a feet LoRA onto a clothed desk scene and skipped the one the moment needed. Director failures now log their cause ('director skipped — …') including the API's actual error body, so the next miss is diagnosable at a glance.
